sources.quote: An approval covers the named manufacturing location only.
APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese)
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.

findings.why: The only approval for BR-220 at TO1 for STL (AP-0311) is for Alluminio B at Settimo Torinese. The Rovereto plant is a different manufacturing location and is not listed. The ASL is the complete list for this part, plant and customer, so Rovereto has no approval.

sources.quote: 8.5.6.1 A change of material source, of a sub-supplier, or of the manufacturing location of a sub-supplier needs a documented risk analysis and written approval from Stellantis before any shipment of affected parts.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: BR-220 is on program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the Stellantis requirements. Moving billet production to another plant of the supplier changes the manufacturing location. That needs a documented risk analysis and written Stellantis approval before shipment. No such approval is in the documents.

sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01 | Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat

findings.why: Only the alloy (6082-T6) was stated verbally. The documents contain no EN 10204 3.1 certificate or tensile result for billet from Rovereto. Without one, Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01) cannot be confirmed. Someone must supply the certificate and test data.
